title: Instrumentation Hygiene Sweep
description: Fold four verified defects into one track: class-body instrumentation correctness (trackers injected into GDScript class bodies make files unparseable and silently drop them from coverage), coverage merge dropping omission reasons, non-atomic writes in three writers, and the dead GUT hook files still shipped and deployed. Includes the accumulated GUT-removal doc debt and small dead-code removals.
